name: fast-switch-projects
description: A keyboard-first project switcher with ordered slots, drag-and-drop reordering, and automatic window opening

untrustedWorkspaces.description: If 'Security > Workspace > Trust: Enabled' is true the feature 'Select Status Bar Color' works only in the current workspace.

viewsWelcome.contents:
You can also open a workspace from Fast Switch Projects.
[Open Workspace](command:fastSwitchProjects.action.workspaces.pickWorkspace)

No workspaces found.
[Add Project](command:fastSwitchProjects.action.workspaces.addProject)
You can scan folders to detect Git repositories, Visual Studio Code folders or workspace files. Open the [Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings) and define folders in which the extension should search.

No tags are available.
[New Tag](command:fastSwitchProjects.action.tag.add)
Organize your workspaces with tags. Each workspace can have multiple tags.

fastSwitchProjects.openInNewWindow.description: Controls whether a workspace should open in a new window.

fastSwitchProjects.openNewProjectsInNewW.description: Controls whether projects selected with Add Project or Add Workspace Project should open immediately in new windows.

fastSwitchProjects.useCacheForDetectedPr.description: Controls whether all detected workspaces should be cached between sessions.

fastSwitchProjects.git.folders.description: Indicates the folders to search for Git repositories.

fastSwitchProjects.git.maxDepthRecursion.description: Indicates the maximum depth of folder recursion to search for Git repositories.

fastSwitchProjects.git.ignore.description: Indicates folders to be ignored, like ".hg", ".svn", "CVS", "node_modules", etc.

fastSwitchProjects.vsCode.folders.description: Indicates the folders to search for Visual Studio Code folders.

fastSwitchProjects.vsCode.maxDepthRecurs.description: Indicates the maximum depth of folder recursion to search for Visual Studio Code folders.

fastSwitchProjects.vsCode.ignore.description: Indicates folders to be ignored, like ".git", ".hg", ".svn", "CVS", "node_modules", etc.

fastSwitchProjects.workspace.folders.description: Indicates the folders to search for Visual Studio Code workspace files.

fastSwitchProjects.workspace.maxDepthRec.description: Indicates the maximum depth of folder recursion to search for Visual Studio Code workspace files.

fastSwitchProjects.workspace.ignore.description: Indicates folders to be ignored, like ".git", ".hg", ".svn", "CVS", "node_modules", etc.

fastSwitchProjects.subfolder.folders.description: Indicates the folders to search for subfolders.

fastSwitchProjects.subfolder.ignore.description: Indicates folders to be ignored, like ".hg", ".git", ".svn", "CVS", "node_modules", etc.

fastSwitchProjects.initialFavoriteGroups.description: Indicates if a favorite group should be collapsed, expanded or remembered in its initial state.
enumDescriptions: Remember the collpased and expanded state of each group.
Show all groups collapsed at start.
Show all groups expanded at start.

fastSwitchProjects.initialWorkspaceGroup.description: Indicates if a workspace group should be collapsed, expanded or remembered in its initial state.
enumDescriptions: Remember the collpased and expanded state of each group.
Show all groups collapsed at start.
Show all groups expanded at start.

fastSwitchProjects.sortWorkspacesBy.description: Indicates how the workspaces should be sorted. Custom groups are always at the top of the tree view followed by pinned groups. If a workspace is part of a custom group, it does not appear in the auto sorted groups anymore.
enumDescriptions: Group all workspaces by root path.

fastSwitchProjects.workspaceDescriptionF.description: Indicates what kind of additional information of a workspace should be visible in the workspaces view.
enumDescriptions: Show the slot number and all tags.

fastSwitchProjects.tagDescriptionFormat.description: Indicates what kind of additional information of a tag should be visible in the tags view.
enumDescriptions: Show the slot number and the amount of workspaces.

fastSwitchProjects.groupDescriptionForma.description: Indicates what kind of additional information of a group should be visible in the workspaces view.
enumDescriptions: Show the slot number and the amount of workspaces.

fastSwitchProjects.showTagsInWorkspaces.description: Controls whether tags should be visible in the workspaces view.

fastSwitchProjects.confirmDeleteFavorite.description: Controls whether a favorite should ask for confirmation when deleting it.

fastSwitchProjects.confirmDeleteProject.description: Controls whether a project should ask for confirmation when deleting it.

fastSwitchProjects.confirmDeleteTag.description: Controls whether a tag should ask for confirmation when deleting it.

fastSwitchProjects.confirmOpenMultipleWi.description: Controls whether a group should ask for confirmation when more than 3 windows should be opened at once.

fastSwitchProjects.autoRemoveDeletedProj.description: Controls whether a deleted project should be removed from workspaces and favorites automatically.

fastSwitchProjects.statusBarAction.description: Indicates the action which will be triggered by click on the statusbar icon.
enumDescriptions: Reveal the workspace in the OS.
